claims: Gerry McIlroy is the father of Rory McIlroy.
Rory McIlroy is a four-time major champion.
Gerry McIlroy is a working-class man from Northern Ireland.
Gerry McIlroy worked multiple jobs including as a bartender at Holywood Golf Club.
Gerry McIlroy introduced Rory McIlroy to golf at age two.
Gerry McIlroy coached Rory McIlroy until he was 17.
Gerry McIlroy grew up in public housing outside Belfast.
Gerry McIlroy played golf at a scratch-handicap level.
Gerry McIlroy worked 100-hour weeks including cleaning toilets and bartending to pay for expensive tournament fees.
Gerry McIlroy said it was "always Rory's dream, not mine".
Gerry McIlroy placed £100 at 500-1 odds that Rory McIlroy would win an Open Championship within 10 years.
Gerry McIlroy won the bet after Rory McIlroy's 2014 victory.
Rory McIlroy won an Open Championship in 2014.
